_about: Public-domain Morgan Cowie, Dean of Exeter, for the Word Hoard: Ten Sermons preached before the University of Cambridge (with his Hulsean Lectures), Scripture Difficulties, On Sacrifice, and Reminiscences of a City Church. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 127 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

cowie-ten-sermons: Ten sermons preached before the University of Cambridge : including the Hulsean lectures for 1853, and two other sermons (London : F. and J. Rivington ; Cambridge : J. Deighton, 1853)
cowie-scripture-difficulties: Scripture difficulties : sermons preached before the University of Cambridge, including the Hulsean lectures for 1854 and three other sermons (London : Rivingtons, 1855)
cowie-on-sacrifice: On sacrifice: the Atonement, Vicarious oblation, and Example of Christ; and The punishment of (catalogued 1856)
cowie-city-church: Reminiscences of a city church : including an account of the missionary services in the Church of S. Lawrence and S. Mary Magdalen, September 1867, vol. Talbot collection of British pamphlets (London : Dalton & Lucy, booksellers to the Queen and to H.R.H. the Prince of Wales, 28 Cockspur Street, Charing Cross, 1867)
